plan.question: 仅依据此项目报告，逐项列出 COMMUNICATION、RX_PRESENT、RUNTIME、RX_RUNTIME 的原始 status/reason，并解释前两项通过为何不能将后两项 unassessed 说成已通过或已失败。只陈述验收原文和原因直接支持的关系；不要补造运行超时、帧内容匹配、根因、物理 ECU 或实车执行。

reference_boundary: Direct report-derived, non-blind reference frozen before target inference; it is not independent human gold and is not included in the model request.

RUNTIME.requirement_text: Protected candidate has same-run CAN observation

RX_RUNTIME.requirement_text: Candidate receive path has same-run observation

reference_explanation: COMMUNICATION 的 passed/linked_in_scope 和 RX_PRESENT 的 passed/observed 仅记录各自结构/存在检查。RUNTIME 为 unassessed/declared_runtime_identity_mismatch，RX_RUNTIME 为 unassessed/another_binding_rejected；它们没有被本报告认定为运行通过或运行失败，项目整体也是 unassessed。前两项通过不能把未评估运行项补写为实际观察成功，也不能从 reason 推出超时、帧内容一致或根因。

budget.retry_policy: no retries; retain blocked/refused/failed content and do not rerun this case

criteria.description: Model prose names all four check IDs and each literal status/reason without omission or merged reasons.
Model explains that static/existence passed checks cannot convert RUNTIME and RX_RUNTIME unassessed to passed or failed, and project acceptance remains unassessed.
Model does not claim radio presence, a measured timeout, frame value equality, root cause, physical ECU, configuration writing or real-vehicle execution.

v0.6 source has 4/4 bound requirement text and pairs, one model call, fixed model version/digest, <=100-second service timeout and <=120-second total budget; protocol passes and offline verifier passes.
v0.6 user-visible summary contains only four verified pairs and fixed boundary; model prose stays separate and unassessed.
With Ollama stopped, the exact saved v0.6 source and presentation verify against the frozen report and plan.

call_policy: Before inference require this freeze commit's head-matching seven-job CI success, exact report/plan/project hashes, absent result paths, and Ollama 0.31.1 with frozen qwen3.5:2b digest. Run read-only Endpoint /api/version and /api/tags preflight in the same authorized network environment as the unique v0.6 CLI call. Use --timeout 100 and --max-seconds 120 to allow cold model loading, still with one model call. Then render v0.6 without another model call, stop Ollama and verify both outputs offline. Any block/refusal/content failure is retained without retry.
boundary: Development-only test of whether bound requirement text limits unsupported explanation beyond deterministic facts; no claim of held-out generalization or independent human review.
